d.f: Confirmed systemic terminal ordering defect: all 10 measured regular terminal closes are followed by accepted Gen4 reassert from immediately retired owner. Final cycle re-enters PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT 916 ms after NATIVE_COVER generation 83 using owner generation 80 and remains non-terminal 3.080 s; terminal return result arrives at 3.997 s.
d.why: App state/generation gate runs before async dispatch; shell Gen4 commands serialize on a single mutation executor; old reassert can therefore run before later terminal return. Shell reassert lacks fresh native-cover terminal fence.
d.next: Primary: add native-cover topology fence to Gen4 prepare/reassert before mutation and again after physical wake before route activation; retain close thresholds/visuals. Add queue-ordering unit tests and Fold7 30-70 oscillation endurance gate.
d.deviceStatus: ORDERING DEVICE-LOG CONFIRMED; FIX NOT YET PHYSICAL-DEVICE VALIDATED

en: Slot 07 complete. Confirmed a systemic post-terminal Gen4 ordering defect on current main: every measured normal close reasserts the retired owner after NATIVE_COVER, and the final bad close leaves that illegal PREWARM window open for 3.080 seconds. The narrow fix is a daemon-side native-cover terminal fence in prepare/reassert, not threshold or visual changes. Full report, proposed fix, deterministic repro, measurements, and beta regression matrix are published for primary.
